description: A sidechain envelope follower producing a ducking voltage for the COMP/CV inputs on the Submit mixers

params.text: Sets how fast the envelope rises towards a louder sidechain, 1ms to 1 second
Sets how fast the envelope falls away once the sidechain quietens, 10ms to 2 seconds
Scales the output, setting the deepest ducking it can ask for
Shapes the envelope: straight, squared, or square-rooted for a faster onset. The bottom position is the straight one, although the panel prints log beside it

inputs.text: A gate above 1V drives the envelope towards full, and it falls back once the voltage drops below 0.1V
The envelope follows the size of this signal, 5V reading as full

outputs.text: The ducking voltage, 0-10V, rising as the sidechain gets louder

notes: the output stays at 0V until a gate or an audio signal arrives. With both patched, the larger of the two envelopes wins rather than the two adding up

inputs.0:
high above 1V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
